review_complete_meaning: All available required evidence categories were inspected; this records completed review, not approval or repair completion.

technical_protocol_blockers.reason: Every curved_back mesh has inconsistent winding. Each evaluated back has 54 inconsistently oriented manifold edges, 24 boundary edges and one near-zero-area face. The actual GLB retains 54 same-direction shared edges per back after position welding.
technical_protocol_blockers.recommendation: Correct the back's face winding and end caps before beveling; eliminate degenerate/open seams. Verify outward orientation on the finished evaluated Blender mesh and exported GLB, then reuse the next version's ten required comparisons.

technical_protocol_blockers.reason: Solid seat cylinders materially intersect: lounge_a chair2/ottoman1 radial overlap 0.254 m; lounge_b chair0/chair1 0.193 m, chair0/ottoman0 0.183 m, chair1/ottoman1 0.221 m; lounge_c chair1/ottoman0 0.119 m. Overlap spans the 0.43 m seat-body height. The actual GLB ceramic pot has 80/288 vertices inside the column's radius, at z=0–0.40 m; deepest radial intrusion 0.347 m.
technical_protocol_blockers.recommendation: Separate the solid bodies using measured multi-view seat/pot outlines and plausible clearances; move/resize only with recorded frame and residual evidence. Keep touching upholstery distinguishable from 12–25 cm body intersections. Repair column and pot together.

technical_protocol_blockers.reason: The only desk component starts at z=0.150 m above a floor inset ending at z=0.018 m: 0.132 m unsupported gap. It has four boundary edges on an open back and no base/feet. The author’s triangulated top endpoints are about z=0.86–0.91 m, while the authored top is z=1.15 m.
technical_protocol_blockers.recommendation: Add a plausible concealed support/plinth marked inferred, or correct the bottom to the support plane. Reconcile the visible top with the accepted endpoint observations before changing height; close the hidden shell or explicitly document it as a non-solid surface proxy.

technical_protocol_blockers.reason: mirror_partition geometry leaves an open 1.05 m wide, 2.25 m high passage at x=[-0.60,0.45], but its single static AABB fills that opening. The façade's bright_glass spans both entry doors continuously; façade and door AABBs also span the full passage. These proxies cannot represent portal traversal. The RGB entry doors appear closed, so their current closed state alone is not an error.
technical_protocol_blockers.recommendation: Split wall collision shapes around the visible open portal. Represent door frames/leaves separately with an explicit closed state and opening semantics, or explicitly mark the façade/entry proxy as non-traversable and unsupported for navigation. Do not leave a solid parent collider behind an intended passage.

technical_protocol_blockers.reason: The first complete input pass is real, has all 180 frames and the current model hash, but its creating invocation is unattributed. The updated author access log explicitly lists the raycast_scene input_v1 invocation among unobserved creating invocations. coordinator_tool_note.json attributes only the ten paired checks/first visualization. Hash validation does not establish the missing command/access provenance.
technical_protocol_blockers.recommendation: Have the originating coordinator/tool session append a method-local record of the actual input_v1 command, actor, time, read/write scope and resulting hash. Preserve the author’s honest uncertainty; do not invent attribution or rerun a full pass solely to fill this record.

issues.finding: Sample118 source has a large column at the left edge while the paired model view has no corresponding column. The 640×480 source-silhouette rectangle [30,80,65,340] has median model-minus-DA3 residual +0.862 m. Column placement is inconsistent across the actual paired silhouettes; entry frame members also appear too thin.
issues.recommendation: Fit a shared cylinder to silhouettes in samples33/108/118/129 while keeping all cameras fixed; use tangency geometry rather than treating different silhouette edges as a single triangulated point. Recheck pot clearance and door-frame width.

issues.finding: Several source pendant silhouettes are absent or displaced. At sample61 rectangle [238,24,340,68] the missing source pendant gives median signed residual +1.320 m; at sample74 [390,5,485,38] it is +1.434 m. Sample129’s large top-centre bowl is missing at its source location. The modeled concentric bands also lose the source woven silhouette/detail.
issues.recommendation: Assign cross-view identities to the missing/displaced bowls, measure rim extrema in at least two views, and update individual positions/heights/radii. Preserve inferred status for unmatched lamps; prioritize silhouette and placement before weave detail.

issues.finding: The paired model shows isolated central bushes instead of the source shrubs spanning each trough. Box silhouettes and occlusion also disagree: sample91 box rectangle [180,224,380,260] has median signed residual -0.520 m; sample82 [286,335,360,394] is -0.258 m. These rectangles include mixed surfaces, not isolated object masks.
issues.recommendation: Reconcile measured trough corners across multiple views, then distribute roots along each trough and match the visible foliage envelope. Do not translate the entire planter from a mixed foliage/background residual alone.

issues.finding: Flat mirrors render as convex metallic discs; inspected cylinder cap polygons are smooth-shaded. Tabletops similarly look domed. The inset floor has rippled reflections rather than the sharp source pattern; walls are substantially paler and the crest nearly disappears. The crest’s single face normal points +X, away from the room.
issues.recommendation: Use flat/split cap normals for mirrors and tabletops, orient the crest toward the room and check its contrast. Reduce floor bump and reconcile roughness/light direction using existing RGB. Keep procedural-material export differences and opaque glazing explicitly limited; never model reflected furniture as new objects.

issues.finding: Own-input depth is conflicting, not truth. Reception-wall rectangles have median signed residuals -2.444 m (33), +2.748 m (129), -1.715 m (155). In the existing full pass, median reference depth changes from 7.689 m at160 to 1.578 m at170 and 0.500 m at179 while model median stays about5.96–5.97 m; the last contact sheet shows a similar RGB view. This prevents interpreting whole-scene input error as a simple geometry/scale correction.
issues.recommendation: Retain the uncertainty and preserve native scale/cameras. Use accepted RGB correspondences and selected credible depth regions to justify local repairs; do not rescale geometry, alter masks or optimize to the aggregate DA3 error.
